title: Bandwidth to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on October 29, 2026
summary: RALEIGH, N.C., Oct. 12, 2026 / PRNewswire / -- Bandwidth Inc. (NASDAQ: BAND), a leading global enterprise cloud communications company, today announced it will report its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 before market open on Thursday, October 29, 2026.
body_markdown:
RALEIGH, N.C.


, Oct. 12, 2026


/ PRNewswire


/ — Bandwidth Inc. (NASDAQ: BAND), a leading global enterprise cloud communications company, today announced it will report its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 before market open on Thursday, October 29, 2026.


Bandwidth will offer a live webcast of the conference call on the Investor Relations section of the company’s website at[https ://investors.bandwidth.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795905-1&h=102372821&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.bandwidth.com%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.bandwidth.com) , where a replay will also be available shortly following the completion of the event.


**Conference call details:**
Date: Thursday, October 29, 2026
Time: 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time
Dial-in number (domestic): 844-481-2707
Dial-in number (international): 412-317-0663


**Replay information:**
Following the completion of the call through Thursday, November 5, 2026, a replay will be available by dialing 855-669-9658 for the U.S. or 412-317-0088 for callers outside the U.S., and entering passcode 4828018.


**About Bandwidth Inc.**
[Bandwidth Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795905-1&h=1551338309&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bandwidth.com%2F&a=Bandwidth+Inc.) (NASDAQ: BAND) is a global cloud communications company that helps enterprises deliver exceptional experiences through voice calling, text messaging and emergency services. Our solutions and our Communications Cloud, covering ~70 countries and 90 percent of global GDP, are trusted by all the leaders in unified communications and cloud contact centers–including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Cisco, Google, Microsoft, RingCentral


, Zoom, Genesys


and Five9–as well as Global 2000 enterprises and SaaS


builders like Docusign


, Uber


and Yosi


Health. As a founder of the cloud communications revolution, we are the first and only global Communications Platform-as-a-Service ( CPaaS


) to offer a unique combination of composable


APIs


, AI capabilities, owner-operated network and broad regulatory experience. Our award-winning support teams help businesses around the world transform their communications every day.
